queries.result: Official Prefeitura pages identify the municipal technical cadastre, geoprocessing unit, and a municipal maps service. The linked map endpoint was separately requested but timed out anonymously; no parcel geometry or schema was verified.

queries.query: Americana SP cadastro imobiliário mapa georreferenciado Prefeitura Unidade de Cadastro Técnico Municipal geoprocessamento
queries.result: Local-language first-party discovery confirmed the Prefeitura's Unidade de Cadastro Técnico Municipal and Unidade de Geoprocessamento, plus the municipal cadastral/tax service. The public cadastral certificate page is a tax/certificate interface, not a safe parcel geometry service; no credentials or property selectors were submitted.

First-party services catalogue links Consulta de Imóveis and Mapas Municipais; the latter links to https://planejamento.americana.sp.gov.br/mapa.
